figurative_meaning_en: The bony structure of the chest (ribcage)
example_sentences_in_bangla: খাঁচার ভিতরে অচিন পাখি কেমনে আসে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: How does an unknown bird come and go inside the cage.
His ribcage was shattered in the accident.
history: References the mystical poetry of Lalon Fakir, a 19th-century Baul saint, symbolizing the soul's entrapment in the body.
note: Primarily used in poetic and spiritual contexts within Bengali folk traditions.
